description.p: r9view opens a comic archive the way a normal viewer opens a picture: point it at a zip, cbz, rar, cbr or 7z and it reads the images inside, in page order, without unpacking anything first. It works just as well on an ordinary folder of images.
It is built for a touchscreen: swipe to turn the page, pinch to zoom, drag to pan, double tap to zoom in on a panel. Everything is on the keyboard too -- arrow keys page and zoom.
